newsitem.title: USA: OPTIONS - U.S. T-bond vols continue to inch up.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - U.S. T-bond vols continue to inch up.

text.p: Implied volatilities for U.S. Treasury bond options continued inching up Wednesday as the underlying bond prices made fresh seven-month highs before retreating slightly, traders said.

Activity was slow in the Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) T-bond pit amid a dearth of important economic data. But an early rally in September futures above 114-00 sparked some interest in options, traders said.
"I'd like to think volatility has bottomed here for a little bit," said Brad Tyl, CBOT floor manager for Aubrey G Lanston.
